subject: Re: Availability for compact technical deep dive / who should join from Stowell
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@stowell.ai>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@briskpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: next step — compact deep dive options + MAP

Hi Sara / Tom —

Great to speak this morning. Quick recap: you want predictable low-latency inference for batch chat agents and a plan to validate cost points for 200–400 reqs/s. To keep momentum, we recommend a focused technical deep dive (20–30 minutes) with our infra engineer and a short mutual action plan (MAP) to capture scope and success criteria.

I had two quick asks so we can lock a time before your calendar frees up:
- Can you confirm who should be on the call from Stowell (platform or infra owner)? If Tom isn’t the right owner, please assign an alternate.
- Which of these 20m slots works for you?
  • Tue Jul 15, 10:00–10:20 PT
  • Wed Jul 16, 14:00–14:20 PT

I’ve attached a one-page MAP draft and the demo slide stub for context — low detail, meant to speed the call. If neither slot works, say the worst time window and we’ll compact it to a 12–15m focused run.

Thanks — speak soon,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-map-v1.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-demo-slides.pptx (application/vnd.ms-powerpoint)
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@stowell.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@briskpay.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: next step — compact deep dive options + MAP

Thanks Ben — appreciate the recap. Sorry — Tom was pulled into an all‑hands and we missed the end of the call.

Quick answers:
- Ownership: I’ll own the initial discovery and bring Alex (our infra lead) if the deep dive needs kernel/infra detail. For procurement/contracting, Tom will stay in the loop.
- Slots: Wed Jul 16, 14:00–14:20 PT works best for Alex and me.

Can you send a calendar invite and a very short agenda (3 bullets)? Also tagging Marissa here — if there’s any prework you want Alex to prepare (logs, request shape), let us know.

—Sara
Sara Nguyen | Head of Product, Stowell AI
sara@stowell.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@stowell.ai>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@briskpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: next step — compact deep dive options + MAP

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirm, Sara. I’ll lock Wed 7/16 14:00–14:20 PT on our side and send a calendar invite now.

Agenda (20m tight):
1) 3m — goal alignment / success metrics (Ben + Sara)
2) 12m — infra walkthrough + typical request profiles (Aditya + Alex)
3) 5m — next steps and MAP sign-off (Ben + Sara + Tom)

Prework for Alex: if you can paste one example request payload and the 95th percentile request size (tokens) in the calendar description, Aditya can prep a tailored perf matrix. If you prefer, drop them here and we’ll keep it internal.

I’m attaching the MAP again and a compact demo slide set. If for some reason you can’t make Wed, we’ll offer a 15m fallback on Thu 7/17 at 11:30 PT.

Sending invite — see you Wed.
Ben
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@briskpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara@stowell.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: next step — compact deep dive options + MAP

Ben — thanks. Wed 7/16 14:00 PT is fine for me to attend briefly at the end for MAP discussion; Alex will take point on technical Qs.

Also, small ask: if procurement likely needs a ballpark monthly $ number for comitting to a dedicated pool, can you include a rough range in the MAP? Doesn’t have to be formal — just to start internal sizing.

Tom
VP, Partnerships (temporary) — BriskPay
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@stowell.ai>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@briskpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: next step — compact deep dive options + MAP

Thanks all — calendar invite sent (Wed 2025-07-16 14:00–14:20 PT). I added a 2‑line prework item in the invite asking for the example payload and 95th percentile size.

Per Tom’s ask, I added a preliminary cost band in the MAP (very rough):
- 95th p99 latency-focused reserved scenario (dedicated GPUs): $8k–$14k / month (depending on model family and quantization)
- Cost-conscious shared-hosted option with autoscaling: $2k–$5k / month estimate for production pilot traffic (subject to final req/s and sequence length)

We’ll refine numbers in the deep dive once we have sample traffic. Attached final MAP v1 and demo slides; I flagged the cost band as draft.

Action items:
- Sara: paste a sample request payload in the calendar or reply here.
- Alex: attend Wed and walk us through the infra constraints.
- Tom: review MAP cost band and flag any redlines for procurement.

If anything changes, ping me and we’ll compress to the 15m Thu fallback.

Best,
Ben
Attachments: redwood-map-v1.pdf, redwood-demo-slides.pptx
